levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن المغيرة

notes: «رجال الكشي» and «[3/128]» are the source's title and number, left out

two routes joined by «؛»: the first ends at العباس بن عامر القصباني; the second («و أيوب بن نوح ...») carries the chain on to Ibn Abi Ya'fur and the Imam; the text does not say the first route continues, so no shared tail is written
the Imam speaks in Ibn Abi Ya'fur's story («فقال: ما فعل بزيع») and is the last link (owner ruling 5)
whether the first route's «العباس بن عامر القصباني» and the second's «العباس بن عامر» are one man is not decided here
